objectives: Increase cross-platform audience engagement by 35% through targeted content strategies
Reduce subscriber churn rate by implementing personalized retention campaigns
deliverables: Interactive mobile app features promoting viewer engagement
Influencer partnership program with 25-30 content creators
Real-time marketing dashboard tracking campaign performance metrics
Comprehensive audience segmentation analysis with behavioral insights
